## Adding a project

Project file: `content/resources/________.md`

- [ ] The resource is public: a public GitHub repository, or a page anyone can open without signing in.
- [ ] It has documentation (such as a README) explaining what the project does and how to use it.
- [ ] It has a license. For a resource outside GitHub, the listing's `license:` line reflects the license as from the source.
- [ ] It contains no identifiable information about people and no data my institution restricts.
- [ ] I removed `draft: true` (or set it to `false`) so the listing will appear.
- [ ] I'm a maintainer of the project, or I have the maintainers' agreement to list it.

The **Build site** check below confirms the file is filled in correctly and, for a
GitHub repository, that the repository can be found. If it fails, open its details to see which field to fix.
